segment.source: Renders instructions as a numbered sequence, each step with an icon, a heading and a sentence or two of what to do. Use it for: a how-to in a help centre, an application procedure, an onboarding checklist, assembly instructions, the stages of a service. Prefer 'Timeline' when the sequence is history rather than instruction, and 'Step Navigation' when each step is a page of its own that the reader has to travel to.
